notes.title: Update to version 0.0.4
notes.content:
Now in Expansion mode, units require the construction of housing. So in order to increase the maximum number of your army, you will have to build and improve houses.
[list]
 [*]In the Expansion mode a new resource - housing is introduced.
 [*]In the Expansion mode, houses buildings have been added.
 [*]In the units inventory are added a slot for provisions.
 [*]Bread now restores health to the wounded units during recharge.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to version 0.0.3
notes.content:
This update was focused mainly on the Expansion mode. I hope this will make the game in this mode more fun and relaxed, like a sandbox, in comparison with the Siege mode.
[list]
[*]Changed the balance of arquebusers (damage reduced by 10, armor increased by 1).
[*]Some descriptions have been changed.
[*]Fixed bug with incorrect protection for units with iron merlons.
[*]Small changes in particles.
[*]Expansion mode changed:
[*]The villages have been replaced by various productional buildings (now there are 7 of them).
[*]Added inventory for units. Now in the Expansion mode, units can be equipped with weapons and armor of their own production, which increases their effectiveness.
[*]Added resources. Now there are 13, they can be sold, or produced some from others (more valuable ones). Some can be transferred to units.
[*]Also, the Expansion mode, there was a rebalance. Enemies now only appear after the construction of productional buildings. The cost of wooden walls is reduced.

Most importantly, the color of the grass is changed :)
[/list]

notes.title: Update to version 0.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Were questions about unusual gameplay. There were a some incomprehensible things, in this update I tried to fix it and make the management more familiar. I also tried to make more detailed hints in the Expansion mode.

[list]
    [*]Fixed a crash associated with hiring a unit after the destruction of the donjon.
    [*]Now the menu can be closed with the Esc key.
    [*]Has been added the icon that turns on / off the fields of view.
    [*]Changed the construction system. Removed the character-builder, now the construction is carried out with the mouse.
    [*]Slightly changed the font and description.
    [*]Added a frame around the selected units.
    [*]The tool for removing previously built walls is added.
    [*]The training has been remade.
[/list]

I hope this will make the game more fun for you.
